cond_0001.intro: This position supports the New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineering team through the programming, fabrication, building, testing, troubleshooting, and modification of prototypes along with establishing machining, methods, and tool sequences to meet required customer specifications and work instructions.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop/modify NC programs of medium/complex NPI projects for various types of machines such as CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Setup and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders by holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications.
Work is done in a low volume high mix environment.
Establishes appropriate machining methods and tool sequences.
Determines the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Possesses working knowledge of CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Employees will use advanced inspection equipment, ex. CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collects and analyzes process data and provides input to the project team.
Trains and assists in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and provide input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Handle engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager, and NPI Project leads.
Handle engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and provide improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
7 To 10 years of experience working on CNC equipment.
Minimum of 2 years of CNC programming experience (Mastercam) and 3 years of CNC setup experience.
High School diploma or equivalent.
Working knowledge of manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing, and materials.
Excellent knowledge of blueprint reading and drawing interpreting, including GD&T.
Ability to program, set up, and run complex jobs without supervision.
Experience working with a wide range of steels (CRS, Aluminum, Hastelloy, Inconel, etc).
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency with CAD/CAM software (Solidworks, AutoCAD, Mastercam).
Proficiency with MS Office tools (Word/Excel).
Experience working with magnet materials.

Develop/modify NC programs of medium/complex NPI projects for various types of machines such as CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Setup and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders by holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications.
Work is done in a low volume high mix environment.
Establishes appropriate machining methods and tool sequences.
Determines the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Possesses working knowledge of CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Employees will use advanced inspection equipment, ex. CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collects and analyzes process data and provides input to the project team.
Trains and assists in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and provide input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Handle engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager, and NPI Project leads.
Handle engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and provide improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.
Successful Essential Skills
Excellent problem-solving skills use rigorous logic and methods to solve problems producing effective solutions to problem statements.
Strong technical skills. Ability to set up and run a variety of machines while holding very tight tolerances with limited direction creating quality parts to spec on prototype parts (first part, good part). Primary equipment: OD, ID, and surface Grinders as well as rough and precision slicers. Lathe, Mill, and EDM machines as a secondary skill.
Strong machine shop math and complex blueprint reading skills, including GD&T.
Able to develop required fixturing and tooling to perform everyday tasks.
Able to understand G and M codes.
Able to adjust programs for optimal speed, reliability, and tool life.
Knowledge and use of a wide variety of precision measuring equipment.
Innovation - Apply our collective machining knowledge to make ""impossible parts"".
Evaluate prints and solid model CAD Files.
To excel in this position, you must leverage those skills to be proficient at CAD/CAM programming, setup, and operation of CNC machines.
Machining on Magnetic Material is a plus.
Successful Essential Behaviors
Is action-oriented and independent. Has a heightened sense of urgency and works at a quick pace (high energy).
Uses creativity to make connections among unrelated notions and is seen as having original thought.
Attention to detail: focus on accuracy, completeness, and following standards, rules, regulations, and requirements.
Cooperative with others and usually helpful to the rest of the team in getting work done.
Upholds the values and beliefs of the organization. Exhibits integrity as a person and in their work. Maintains appropriate confidentiality at work.
Is personally committed to and actively works to continuously improve his/her work skills.
Has a can-do, will-do attitude.
Work Environment and Physical Demands
Works in a clean, air-conditioned, and well-lit production environment - protective foot and eyewear required.
60% Standing on cement floors with rubber mats, 20% Sitting, 10% Stooping and Bending and 10% Walking.
Lift and transport an average weight of 10 lbs., maximum of 40 lbs.
Manual dexterity of both hands.
Near Visual Acuity (either corrected or uncorrected).
Ability to understand verbal direction and instruction. Ability to give feedback to engineers and brainstorm with others on the prototype team. Must be able to read, understand, and comply with all quality and safety regulations.
Interactions
Regular contact and communications with all levels of the organization.
Supervision Provided
None
How This Position Contributes to the Effectiveness of the Quality Management System
The Sr. Prototype Machinist is responsible for manufacturing the first piece article according to customer specifications. That work is critical to securing customer approval to move forward in the manufacturing process.
Failure to meet quality standards can result in not securing the order from the customer.
Job Descriptions are influenced by environmental change, the company's objectives, products, and processes. They can change at any time due to business needs.
cond_0020.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise working on CNC equipment.
Proven track record in CNC programming (Mastercam), with a minimum of 2 years, and at least 3 years of CNC setup experience.
High School diploma or equivalent.
Advanced knowledge of manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing, and materials.
Deep knowledge of blueprint reading and drawing interpretation; GD&T required.
Expertise in CAD/CAM software (Solidworks, AutoCAD, Mastercam).
Proven ability to program, set up, and run complex jobs without supervision.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience working with a wide range of steels (CRS, Aluminum, Hastelloy, Inconel, etc.).
Experience working with magnet materials.

cond_0098.intro: This position owns the programming, fabrication, building, testing, troubleshooting, and modification of prototypes for the New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineering team. You will establish machining methods and tool sequences to meet customer specifications and work instructions.
cond_0098.responsibilities:
Develop and modify NC programs for medium/complex NPI projects across CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Set up and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders, holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications in a low volume high mix environment.
Determine appropriate machining methods, tool sequences, fixturing, and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Apply CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Execute advanced inspection using equipment such as CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collect and analyze process data and deliver input to the project team.
Lead training and development of personnel through cross-training.
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S, and housekeeping duties.
Drive input during concept development and feasibility testing as part of the product development process.
Manage the engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager and NPI Project leads.
Own the engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and deliver improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.

Minimum of 2 years of CNC programming experience (Mastercam) and 3 years of CNC setup experience

Able to understand G and M codes

Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and provide input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Handle engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager, and NPI Project leads.
Handle engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and provide improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.

cond_0206.intro: This position owns the programming, fabrication, building, testing, troubleshooting, and modification of prototypes for the New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineering team. You will establish machining methods and tool sequences to meet customer specifications and work instructions.
cond_0206.responsibilities:
Develop and modify NC programs for medium/complex NPI projects across CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Set up and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders, holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications in a low volume high mix environment.
Determine appropriate machining methods, tool sequences, fixturing, and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Apply CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Execute advanced inspection using equipment such as CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collect and analyze process data and deliver input to the project team.
Lead training and development of personnel through cross-training.
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S, and housekeeping duties.
Drive input during concept development and feasibility testing as part of the product development process.
Manage the engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager and NPI Project leads.
Own the engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and deliver improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.

cond_0239.intro: This position supports the New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineering team through the programming, fabrication, building, testing, troubleshooting, and modification of prototypes along with establishing machining, methods, and tool sequences to meet required customer specifications and work instructions. People typically grow stronger in this kind of CNC programming and prototype machining work over time as they build experience and learn from hands-on feedback.
cond_0239.responsibilities:
Develop/modify NC programs of medium/complex NPI projects for various types of machines such as CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Setup and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders by holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications.
Work is done in a low volume high mix environment.
Establishes appropriate machining methods and tool sequences.
Determines the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Possesses working knowledge of CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Employees will use advanced inspection equipment, ex. CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collects and analyzes process data and provides input to the project team.
Trains and assists in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and provide input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Handle engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager, and NPI Project leads.
Handle engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and provide improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.
Successful Essential Skills
Excellent problem-solving skills use rigorous logic and methods to solve problems producing effective solutions to problem statements.
Strong technical skills. Ability to set up and run a variety of machines while holding very tight tolerances with limited direction creating quality parts to spec on prototype parts (first part, good part). Primary equipment: OD, ID, and surface Grinders as well as rough and precision slicers. Lathe, Mill, and EDM machines as a secondary skill.
Strong machine shop math and complex blueprint reading skills, including GD&T.
Able to develop required fixturing and tooling to perform everyday tasks.
Able to understand G and M codes.
Able to adjust programs for optimal speed, reliability, and tool life.
Knowledge and use of a wide variety of precision measuring equipment.
Innovation - Apply our collective machining knowledge to make ""impossible parts"".
Evaluate prints and solid model CAD Files.
To excel in this position, you must leverage those skills to be proficient at CAD/CAM programming, setup, and operation of CNC machines.
Machining on Magnetic Material is a plus.
Successful Essential Behaviors
Is action-oriented and independent. Has a heightened sense of urgency and works at a quick pace (high energy).
Uses creativity to make connections among unrelated notions and is seen as having original thought.
Attention to detail: focus on accuracy, completeness, and following standards, rules, regulations, and requirements.
Cooperative with others and usually helpful to the rest of the team in getting work done.
Upholds the values and beliefs of the organization. Exhibits integrity as a person and in their work. Maintains appropriate confidentiality at work.
Is personally committed to and actively works to continuously improve his/her work skills.
Has a can-do, will-do attitude.
Work Environment and Physical Demands
Works in a clean, air-conditioned, and well-lit production environment - protective foot and eyewear required.
60% Standing on cement floors with rubber mats, 20% Sitting, 10% Stooping and Bending and 10% Walking.
Lift and transport an average weight of 10 lbs., maximum of 40 lbs.
Manual dexterity of both hands.
Near Visual Acuity (either corrected or uncorrected).
Ability to understand verbal direction and instruction. Ability to give feedback to engineers and brainstorm with others on the prototype team. Must be able to read, understand, and comply with all quality and safety regulations.
Interactions
Regular contact and communications with all levels of the organization.
Supervision Provided
None

The Sr. Prototype Machinist is responsible for manufacturing the first piece article according to customer specifications. That work is critical to securing customer approval to move forward in the manufacturing process.
Failure to meet quality standards can result in not securing the order from the customer.

Advanced knowledge of manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing, and materials.
Strong command of CAD/CAM software (Solidworks, AutoCAD, Mastercam), skills and abilities.
Exceptional knowledge of blueprint reading and drawing interpreting. GD&T required.
Proven track record working with a wide range of steels (CRS, Aluminum, Hastelloy, Inconel, etc).

Proficiency with MS Office tools (Word/Excel).

Exceptional problem-solving skills; uses rigorous logic and methods to solve problems producing effective solutions to problem statements.

Proven ability to develop required fixturing and tooling to perform everyday tasks.
Solid understanding of G and M codes.
Demonstrated ability to adjust programs for optimal speed, reliability, and tool life.
Advanced knowledge and use of a wide variety of precision measuring equipment.

Deep expertise in CAD/CAM programming, setup, and operation of CNC machines.

Works in a clean, air-conditioned, and well-lit production environment - protective foot and eyewear required.

Manual dexterity of both hands.
Near Visual Acuity (either corrected or uncorrected).

Regular contact and communications with all levels of the organization.

None

cond_0246.responsibilities:
Develop/modify NC programs of medium/complex NPI projects for various types of machines such as CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Setup and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders by holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications.

Determines the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.

Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collects and analyzes process data and provides input to the project team.
Trains and assists in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and provide input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Handle engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager, and NPI Project leads.
Handle engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and provide improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.

Must have a minimum of 2 years of CNC programming experience (Mastercam) and 3 years of CNC setup experience.
High School diploma or equivalent.
Working knowledge of manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing, and materials.
Proficiency with CAD/CAM software knowledge (Solidworks, AutoCAD, Mastercam), skills and abilities.
Excellent knowledge of blueprint reading and drawing interpreting. GD&T required.
Experience working with a wide range of steels. (CRS, Aluminum, Hastelloy, Inconel, etc).

Successful Essential Skills
Excellent problem-solving skills use rigorous logic and methods to solve problems producing effective solutions to problem statements.
Strong technical skills. Strong machine shop math and complex blueprint reading skills, including GD&T.
Able to develop required fixturing and tooling to perform everyday tasks.
Able to understand G and M codes.
Able to adjust programs for optimal speed, reliability, and tool life.
Knowledge and use of a wide variety of precision measuring equipment.

Is action-oriented and independent. Has a heightened sense of urgency and works at a quick pace (high energy).

Cooperative with others and usually helpful to the rest of the team in getting work done.

Manual dexterity of both hands.
Near Visual Acuity (either corrected or uncorrected).
Ability to understand verbal direction and instruction. Ability to give feedback to engineers and brainstorm with others on the prototype team. Must be able to read, understand, and comply with all quality and safety regulations.

Regular contact and communications with all levels of the organization.

cond_0378.intro: This position supports the New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineering team through the programming, fabrication, building, testing, troubleshooting, and modification of prototypes, along with coordinating on machining methods and tool sequences to meet required customer specifications and work instructions.
cond_0378.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the NPI Engineering team to develop and modify NC programs for medium/complex NPI projects across various machine types including CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Set up and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders, holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications. Work is done in a low volume high mix environment.
Work with the team to establish appropriate machining methods and tool sequences.
Help determine the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Use CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Use advanced inspection equipment, including CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collect and analyze process data and share input with the project team.
Train and assist in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and contribute input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Coordinate the engineering model shop schedule with the Manager and NPI Project leads.
Support the engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and share improvement feedback with Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.

cond_0447.intro: This position supports the New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineering team through the programming, fabrication, building, testing, troubleshooting, and modification of prototypes, along with establishing machining methods and tool sequences to meet required customer specifications and work instructions. A regular part of the role involves communicating with engineers, project leads, and team members to keep prototype work on track.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
Develop/modify NC programs of medium/complex NPI projects for various types of machines such as CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Setup and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders by holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications. Work is done in a low volume high mix environment.
Establishes appropriate machining methods and tool sequences.
Determines the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Possesses working knowledge of CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Employees will use advanced inspection equipment, ex. CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collects and analyzes process data and actively shares input with the project team.
Trains and assists in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and speak up during concept development and feasibility testing.
Coordinate the engineering model shop schedule directly with the Manager and NPI Project leads.
Handle engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and communicate improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.

Develop/modify NC programs of medium/complex NPI projects for various types of machines such as CNC lathes, CNC mills, multi-axis machines (3, 4, and 5 axis), CNC mill/turn, wire EDM, sinker EDM, and Jig-grinding.
Setup and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders by holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications. Work is done in a low volume high mix environment.
Establish appropriate machining methods and tool sequences.
Determine the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Use CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Use advanced inspection equipment, including CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collect and analyze process data and provide input to the project team.
Train and assist in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and provide input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Manage the engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager and NPI Project leads.
Maintain the engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and provide improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.
cond_0466.requirements:
7 To 10 years of experience working on CNC equipment.
Minimum of 2 years of CNC programming experience (Mastercam) and 3 years of CNC setup experience.
High School diploma or equivalent.
Working knowledge of manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing, and materials.
Proficiency with CAD/CAM software (Solidworks, AutoCAD, Mastercam).
Strong knowledge of blueprint reading and drawing interpreting. GD&T required.
Experience working with a wide range of steels (CRS, Aluminum, Hastelloy, Inconel, etc).
Experience working with magnet materials is a plus.
Ability to program, set up, and run complex jobs without supervision.
Proficiency with MS Office tools (Word/Excel).
Strong problem-solving skills using rigorous logic and methods to produce effective solutions.
Ability to set up and run a variety of machines while holding very tight tolerances with limited direction, producing quality parts to spec on prototype parts (first part, good part). Primary equipment: OD, ID, and surface grinders as well as rough and precision slicers. Lathe, Mill, and EDM machines as a secondary skill.
Strong machine shop math and complex blueprint reading skills, including GD&T.
Able to develop required fixturing and tooling to perform everyday tasks.
Able to understand G and M codes.
Able to adjust programs for optimal speed, reliability, and tool life.
Knowledge and use of a wide variety of precision measuring equipment.
Ability to apply collective machining knowledge to produce difficult parts.
Able to evaluate prints and solid model CAD files.
Proficiency at CAD/CAM programming, setup, and operation of CNC machines.
Machining on magnetic material is a plus.
Action-oriented and independent, with attention to accuracy and completeness.
Creative thinker with ability to make connections across unrelated concepts.
Attention to detail: focus on accuracy, completeness, and following standards, rules, regulations, and requirements.
Cooperative with others and helpful to the team in getting work done.
Upholds organizational values and exhibits integrity. Maintains appropriate confidentiality at work.
Committed to continuously improving work skills.
Can-do, will-do attitude.

Works in a clean, air-conditioned, and well-lit production environment - protective foot and eyewear required.

Setup and operate powered machines such as 5-axis CNC mills, CNC lathes, wire EDM, sinker EDM, Jig-grinding, and surface grinders by holding extremely tight tolerances (+/- 2 microns) to customer drawing and quality specifications.
Work is done in a low volume high mix environment.
Establishes appropriate machining methods and tool sequences.
Determines the necessary fixturing and tooling to maintain tight tolerances.
Possesses working knowledge of CAD (Solidworks/AutoCAD) and CAM software (Mastercam) to create efficient and repeatable toolpaths.
Employees will use advanced inspection equipment, ex. CMM and digital optical measuring.
Create and maintain job documentation files.
Collects and analyzes process data and provides input to the project team.
Trains and assists in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and provide input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Handle engineering model shop schedule in coordination with the Manager, and NPI Project leads.
Handle engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and provide improvement feedback to Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.
Successful Essential Skills
Excellent problem-solving skills use rigorous logic and methods to solve problems producing effective solutions to problem statements.
Strong technical skills. Ability to set up and run a variety of machines while holding very tight tolerances with limited direction creating quality parts to spec on prototype parts (first part, good part). Primary equipment: OD, ID, and surface Grinders as well as rough and precision slicers. Lathe, Mill, and EDM machines as a secondary skill.
Strong machine shop math and complex blueprint reading skills, including GD&T.
Able to develop required fixturing and tooling to perform everyday tasks.
Able to understand G and M codes.
Able to adjust programs for optimal speed, reliability, and tool life.
Knowledge and use of a wide variety of precision measuring equipment.
Innovation - Apply our collective machining knowledge to make ""impossible parts"".
Evaluate prints and solid model CAD Files.
To excel in this position, you must leverage those skills to be proficient at CAD/CAM programming, setup, and operation of CNC machines.
Machining on Magnetic Material is a plus.
Successful Essential Behaviors
Is action-oriented and independent. Has a heightened sense of urgency and works at a quick pace (high energy).
Uses creativity to make connections among unrelated notions and is seen as having original thought.
Attention to detail: focus on accuracy, completeness, and following standards, rules, regulations, and requirements.
Cooperative with others and usually helpful to the rest of the team in getting work done.
Upholds the values and beliefs of the organization. Exhibits integrity as a person and in their work. Maintains appropriate confidentiality at work.
Is personally committed to and actively works to continuously improve his/her work skills.
Has a can-do, will-do attitude.
Work Environment and Physical Demands
Works in a clean, air-conditioned, and well-lit production environment - protective foot and eyewear required.
60% Standing on cement floors with rubber mats, 20% Sitting, 10% Stooping and Bending and 10% Walking.
Lift and transport an average weight of 10 lbs., maximum of 40 lbs.
Manual dexterity of both hands.
Near Visual Acuity (either corrected or uncorrected).
Ability to understand verbal direction and instruction. Ability to give feedback to engineers and brainstorm with others on the prototype team. Must be able to read, understand, and comply with all quality and safety regulations.
Interactions
Regular contact and communications with all levels of the organization.
Supervision Provided
None

Failure to meet quality standards can result in not securing the order from the customer.

Train and assist in the development of personnel (cross-training).
Conduct preventative maintenance, 5S and housekeeping duties.
Participate in the product development process and contribute input during concept development and feasibility testing.
Coordinate the engineering model shop schedule with the Manager and NPI Project leads.
Support the engineering model shop safety program, including PPE and training requirements.
Assess the manufacturability of new designs and share improvement feedback with Engineers.
Perform other duties as required.
